annotations.text:
CHOSEN and built.

Drops the Live Now card, merges ATP/WTA into one tinted list instead of the PWA's two columns, and puts your standing on the home screen — which the website never did.

C's countdown treatment survives here: on a card that HAS a deadline, the number is the loudest thing on it.

B — SCOREBOARD
Rows, not cards. Most information per screen of the three.
Not chosen: reads as data rather than an app, and nothing invites a tap.

C — DEADLINE FIRST
One dominant thing: the next lock, as a clock, with the action attached.
Not chosen: out of season the hero has nothing to say — and out of season is today. Its idea lives on in the chosen design's countdown.
